downloads.agentInstruction: Configure LiG ({variant}) for my installed tools. Read {page}, {manifest} and {notes}. First detect my OS and installed tools ({tools}) read-only, tell me what you found and what you would change, and wait for my go-ahead. Once confirmed: back up the files you touch, merge only the color settings, keep my existing bindings and layouts, then report what changed and how to roll back.
